# H&W Publishing - Frontend Test Case

This is a 5-page sales funnel website built for H&W Publishing. It showcases a rare first-edition Demian by Hermann Hesse.

## Tech Stack
- Vanilla JavaScript
- Pure CSS with custom properties
- Rsbuild (bundler)
- GSAP (animations)
- Embla Carousel (vanilla carousel)
- Vitest + Testing Library (testing)

## Architecture
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Pure functions (no anonymous functions)
- Early return pattern
- Event-driven using Pub/Sub
- Path aliases: @core, @features, @pages, @locales, @css
- TDD workflow

## Features
- Landing page: The main product showcase
- Upsell: Companion book offer (Steppenwolf) revealed after video
- Thank You: Order confirmation and shipping details
- Legal: Terms and privacy pages

## Project Structure
```
hw-publishing-frontend-test/
├── pages/
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── upsell.html
│   ├── thank-you.html
│   ├── terms.html
│   └── privacy.html
├── src/
│   ├── css/
│   ├── js/
│   └── locales/
├── tests/
└── documentation/
```

## Build Commands
```bash
npm install
npm run dev      # Development server (port 3000)
npm run build    # Production build
npm test         # Test (watch mode)
npm run test:run # Test (single run)
```
